svg.title: Working model of the exploration gate
svg.desc: Medial zona incerta is the strongest causal novelty-investigation node; it gates PAG and the cuneiform nucleus, while hypothalamic nuclei supply body-state permission, arousal and novelty-memory routing.
svg.text: Novelty can pull behavior, but body state and threat decide whether exploration is broad, need-directed, or suppressed.
Best causal evidence: medial zona incerta
a diencephalic action gate, not a classical hypothalamic nucleus
but narrow it toward food, water,
This is a working synthesis: ZI supplies the clearest directed novelty-investigation evidence; hypothalamic nodes supply arousal,
